theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = ∫⁻ x in M ∩ W, ENNReal.ofReal (θ x) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω, S ω = (a : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (b : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S) → ∀ m : ℕ, ∃ c : ℝ≥0, ∀ X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity X → X.mass < ∞ → X.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∀ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ → ∃ (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) (m + 1) → ℝ) (Pc S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (m + 1)), IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc ∧ (∀ F, ∃ k : ℤ, β F = k) ∧ (∀ F, β F ≠ 0 → latticeFace ρ F ⊆ cthickening (Real.sqrt ((m + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * ρ) X.support) ∧ (∀ F, ENNReal.ofReal (|β F| * ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ 2 * X.mass) ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω, X ω - Pc ω = S ω) ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * X.boundary.mass
